name: Fresh Seedless Watermelon Slices
whyItWorks: Watermelon delivers superior hydration and virtually zero insoluble fiber (only 0.6g per wedge). It is refreshing and replenishes intracellular fluid during hot weather or illness.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy strictly seedless watermelon. Discard any stray white or black seeds and do not chew down into the tough white rind.
watchOuts: High in free fructose; eating huge wedges at once can cause osmotic gas or loose stools in fructose-sensitive IBD patients.
